articles.title_en: A residual bootstrap for conditional Value-at-Risk
articles.title_cn: 条件风险价值的残差自助法
articles.abstract_en: A fixed-design residual bootstrap method is proposed for the two-step estimator of Francq and Zakoïan(2015) associated with the conditional Value-at-Risk. The bootstrap’s consistency is proven for a general class of volatility models and intervals are constructed for the conditional Value-at-Risk. A simulation study reveals that the equal-tailed percentile bootstrap interval tends to fall short of its nominal value. In contrast, the reversed-tails bootstrap interval yields accurate coverage. We also compare the theoretically analyzed fixed-design bootstrap with the recursive-design bootstrap. It turns out that the fixed-design bootstrap performs equally well in terms of average coverage, yet leads on average to shorter intervals in smaller samples. An empirical application illustrates the interval estimation.
articles.abstract_cn: 针对Francq和Zakoïan（2015）提出的条件风险价值两步估计量，提出了一种固定设计残差自助法。证明了该自助法在一类广泛的波动率模型下的一致性，并为条件风险价值构建了区间。模拟研究表明，等尾百分位自助区间往往低于其名义值。相反，反转尾部自助区间提供了准确的覆盖率。我们还将理论上分析的固定设计自助法与递归设计自助法进行了比较。结果表明，固定设计自助法在平均覆盖率方面表现同样良好，但在较小样本中平均产生更短的区间。实证应用说明了区间估计。

articles.title_en: Profiling the plight of disconnected youth in America
articles.title_cn: 描绘美国失联青年的困境
articles.abstract_en: In a successful transition from youth to adulthood, individuals pass through a sequence of roles involving school, work, and family formation that culminate in their becoming self-sufficient adults. However, some “disconnected” youth spend extended periods of time outside of any role that constitutes an element of the pathway towards adult independence. Assisting these youth requires a systematic understanding of what “disconnection” means, how many disconnected youth there are, who these youth are, and how the scale of the problem has evolved over time. Using the National Longitudinal Surveys of Youth for 1997 and 1979, we address these issues by creating concrete definitions of “disconnection spells” using rich data on youths’ enrollment, work, and personal histories. We estimate a multi-state duration model to account for right censoring and to understand differences across salient sub-groups. Our estimates imply that in the early 2000s, almost 19% and 25% of young men and young women, respectively, experienced a disconnection spell by age 23 using our basic definition. These rates are substantially higher for certain sub-groups defined by race/ethnicity, parental education, and government aid receipt, rising as high as 30+% by age 23. Approximately 60% of youth with a disconnection spell have it last longer than a year, and close to 10% have it last longer than 4 years. However, once reconnected, a majority of youth go at least three years without a re-disconnection spell. Patterns of initial disconnection changed markedly from the 1980s to the 2000s, as young women saw a 12 percentage point decline over time. Moreover, the Black-White gap in disconnection has fallen for women, but increased for men. Our profile of disconnection experiences provides a starting point for government agencies aiming to understand where, how, and with whom to intervene to prevent lengthy disconnection spells.
articles.abstract_cn: 在从青年到成年的成功过渡中，个体经历一系列涉及学校、工作和家庭形成的角色，最终成为自给自足的成年人。然而，一些“失联”青年在构成通往成年独立路径的任何角色之外度过长时间。帮助这些青年需要系统理解“失联”的含义、失联青年的数量、这些青年是谁，以及问题规模如何随时间演变。利用1997年和1979年的全国青年纵向调查，我们通过使用关于青年入学、工作和个人历史的丰富数据，创建“失联期”的具体定义来解决这些问题。我们估计了一个多状态持续时间模型，以考虑右删失并理解显著亚组之间的差异。我们的估计表明，在2000年代初，根据我们的基本定义，近19%的年轻男性和25%的年轻女性在23岁前经历了失联期。对于某些按种族/民族、父母教育和政府援助接收定义的亚组，这些比率显著更高，到30岁时高达23以上。大约60%有失联期的青年持续时间超过一年，近10%持续时间超过4年。然而，一旦重新连接，大多数青年至少三年内不会再次失联。从1980年代到2000年代，初始失联模式发生了显著变化，年轻女性的失联率下降了12个百分点。此外，女性的黑人与白人失联差距缩小，但男性则扩大。我们对失联经历的描绘为政府机构提供了一个起点，以了解在何处、如何以及与谁干预以防止长期失联期。

articles.title_en: Sharp bounds in the latent index selection model
articles.title_cn: 潜在指数选择模型中的尖锐边界
articles.abstract_en: A fundamental question underlying the literature on partial identification is: what can we learn about parameters that are relevant for policy but not necessarily point-identified by the exogenous variation we observe? This paper provides an answer in terms of sharp, analytic characterizations and bounds for an important class of policy-relevant treatment effects, consisting of marginal treatment effects and linear functionals thereof, in the latent index selection model as formalized in Vytlacil (2002). The sharp bounds use the full content of identified marginal distributions, and analytic derivations rely on the theory of stochastic orders. The proposed methods also make it possible to sharply incorporate new auxiliary assumptions on distributions into the latent index selection framework. Empirically, I apply the methods to study the effects of Medicaid on emergency room utilization in the Oregon Health Insurance Experiment, showing that the predictions from extrapolations based on a distribution assumption (rank similarity) differ substantively and consistently from existing extrapolations based on a parametric mean assumption (linearity). This underscores the value of utilizing the model’s full empirical content in combination with auxiliary assumptions.
articles.abstract_cn: 部分识别文献背后的一个基本问题是：对于与政策相关但未必由我们观察到的外生变异所点识别的参数，我们能了解到什么？本文通过尖锐的分析性刻画和边界，为潜在指数选择模型中一类重要的政策相关处理效应（包括边际处理效应及其线性泛函）提供了答案，该模型由Vytlacil（2002）形式化。尖锐边界利用了已识别边际分布的全部内容，分析推导依赖于随机序理论。所提出的方法还使得能够将新的辅助分布假设尖锐地纳入潜在指数选择框架。在实证中，我将这些方法应用于研究俄勒冈健康保险实验中医疗补助对急诊室利用的影响，表明基于分布假设（秩相似性）的外推预测与基于参数均值假设（线性）的现有外推在实质上且一致地存在差异。这强调了利用模型全部经验内容并结合辅助假设的价值。

articles.title_en: An information–Theoretic approach to partially identified auction models
articles.title_cn: 部分识别拍卖模型的信息论方法
articles.abstract_en: We consider a situation in which we have data from ascending auctions with symmetric bidders, independent private values, and exogenous entry in which the bidders’ value distribution is partially identified. Focusing on the case in which the seller intends to use a second price auction, we discuss how to determine an optimal reserve price. We justify the use of maximum entropy, explore the properties of the estimand, determine the asymptotic properties of our maximum entropy estimator, evaluate its behavior in a simulation study, and demonstrate its use in a modest application. As an extension, we propose a maxmin decision rule with entropy regularization, which includes Aryal and Kim (2013) and the maximum entropy solution as extreme cases.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑一种情况，即我们拥有来自对称竞标者、独立私人价值和外生进入的升价拍卖数据，其中竞标者的价值分布是部分识别的。关注卖方打算使用第二价格拍卖的情形，我们讨论如何确定最优保留价格。我们论证了最大熵的使用，探讨了估计量的性质，确定了我们的最大熵估计量的渐近性质，在模拟研究中评估了其行为，并在一个适度的应用中展示了其使用。作为扩展，我们提出了一种带有熵正则化的最大最小决策规则，该规则将Aryal和Kim（2013）和最大熵解作为极端情况包含在内。

articles.title_en: Identification and estimation of sequential games of incomplete information with multiple equilibria
articles.title_cn: 多重均衡下不完全信息序贯博弈的识别与估计
articles.abstract_en: This paper discusses the identification and estimation of game-theoretic models, mainly focusing on sequential games of incomplete information. In most empirical games, researchers cannot observe the exact order of actions played in the game and rely on the assumption of simultaneous actions. My structural modeling generalizes an empirical game to encompass simultaneous and sequential actions as special cases. I specify a sequential game allowing for multiple players in each stage and multiple Perfect Bayesian Nash Equilibria, showing that the structural parameters, including the payoff function parameters, the order of actions, and the equilibrium selection mechanism, are separately identified. The various exclusion restrictions in the finite mixture literature help attain point identification of structural parameters and provide a testable method to verify identification conditions. Next, I consider a Sieve Minimum Distance (SMD) estimator of Ai and Chen (2003) for the structural parameters and verify its asymptotic properties. The Monte Carlo simulations evaluate the performance of the proposed estimator and provide numerical evidence of potential bias under the misspecified order of actions. The empirical application of Walmart and Kmart’s entry game demonstrates that retailers compete sequentially in a significant portion of markets.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文讨论了博弈论模型的识别与估计，主要关注不完全信息的序贯博弈。在大多数实证博弈中，研究者无法观察到博弈中行动的确切顺序，并依赖于同时行动的假设。我的结构建模将实证博弈推广为涵盖同时行动和序贯行动作为特例。我指定了一个允许每个阶段有多个参与者和多个完美贝叶斯纳什均衡的序贯博弈，表明结构参数，包括支付函数参数、行动顺序和均衡选择机制，是分别识别的。有限混合文献中的各种排除限制有助于实现结构参数的点识别，并提供了一种可检验的方法来验证识别条件。接下来，我考虑了Ai和Chen（2003）的结构参数筛最小距离（SMD）估计量，并验证了其渐近性质。蒙特卡洛模拟评估了所提出估计量的性能，并提供了在错误指定行动顺序下潜在偏差的数值证据。沃尔玛和凯马特的进入博弈的实证应用表明，零售商在相当一部分市场中是序贯竞争的。

articles.title_en: Unconditional effects of general policy interventions
articles.title_cn: 一般政策干预的无条件效应
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the unconditional effects of a general policy intervention, which includes location-scale shifts and simultaneous shifts as special cases. The location-scale shift is intended to study a counterfactual policy aimed at changing not only the mean or location of a covariate but also its dispersion or scale. The simultaneous shift refers to the situation where shifts in two or more covariates take place simultaneously. For example, a shift in one covariate is compensated at a certain rate by a shift in another covariate. Not accounting for these possible scale or simultaneous shifts will result in an incorrect assessment of the potential policy effects on an outcome variable of interest. The unconditional policy parameters are estimated with simple semiparametric estimators, for which asymptotic properties are studied. Monte Carlo simulations are implemented to study their finite sample performances. The proposed approach is applied to a Mincer equation to study the effects of changing years of education on wages and to study the effect of smoking during pregnancy on birth weight.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了一般政策干预的无条件效应，该干预包括位置-尺度平移和同时平移作为特例。位置-尺度平移旨在研究旨在不仅改变协变量的均值或位置，还改变其离散度或尺度的反事实政策。同时平移指的是两个或多个协变量的平移同时发生的情况。例如，一个协变量的平移以一定比率由另一个协变量的平移所补偿。不考虑这些可能的尺度或同时平移将导致对感兴趣的结果变量的潜在政策效应的错误评估。无条件政策参数用简单的半参数估计量估计，并研究了其渐近性质。进行了蒙特卡洛模拟以研究其有限样本性能。所提出的方法应用于明瑟方程，以研究教育年限变化对工资的影响，并研究怀孕期间吸烟对出生体重的影响。

articles.title_en: Role models and revealed gender-specific costs of STEM in an extended Roy model of major choice
articles.title_cn: 角色模型与扩展罗伊模型下专业选择中揭示的STEM性别特定成本
articles.abstract_en: We derive sharp bounds on the non consumption utility component in an extended Roy model of sector selection. We interpret this non consumption utility component as a compensating wage differential. The bounds are derived under the assumption that potential utilities in each sector are (jointly) stochastically monotone with respect to an observed selection shifter. The research is motivated by the analysis of women’s choice of university major, their under representation in mathematics intensive fields, and the impact of role models on choices and outcomes. To illustrate our methodology, we investigate the cost of STEM fields with data from a German graduate survey, and using the mother’s education level and the proportion of women on the STEM faculty at the time of major choice as selection shifters.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在一个扩展的罗伊部门选择模型中推导出非消费效用成分的尖锐边界。我们将这一非消费效用成分解释为补偿性工资差异。这些边界是在假设每个部门的潜在效用相对于观察到的选择转移变量（联合）随机单调的情况下推导出来的。该研究受到女性大学专业选择、在数学密集型领域代表性不足以及角色模型对选择和结果影响的动机驱动。为说明我们的方法，我们使用德国毕业生调查数据，并以母亲的教育水平和专业选择时STEM学院女性比例作为选择转移变量，调查STEM领域的成本。

articles.title_en: Estimation of complier expected shortfall treatment effects with a binary instrumental variable
articles.title_cn: 二元工具变量下依从者预期短缺处理效应的估计
articles.abstract_en: Estimating the causal effect of a treatment or exposure for a subpopulation is of great interest in many biomedical and economical studies. Expected shortfall, also referred to as the super-quantile, is an attractive effect-size measure that can accommodate data heterogeneity and aggregate local information of effect over a certain region of interest of the outcome distribution. In this article, we propose the ComplieRExpected Shortfall Treatment Effect (CRESTE) model under an instrumental variable framework to quantity the CRESTE for a binary endogenous treatment variable. By utilizing the special characteristics of a binary instrumental variable and a specific formulation of Neyman-orthogonalization, we propose a two-step estimation procedure, which can be implemented by simply solving weighted least-squares regression and weighted quantile regression with estimated weights. We develop the asymptotic properties for the proposed estimator and use numerical simulations to confirm its validity and robust finite-sample performance. An illustrative analysis of a National Job Training Partnership Act study is presented to show the practical utility of the proposed method.
articles.abstract_cn: 在许多生物医学和经济学研究中，估计治疗或暴露对某一亚群体的因果效应具有重要意义。预期短缺，也称为超分位数，是一种有吸引力的效应量度量，能够适应数据异质性，并汇总结果分布中特定感兴趣区域效应的局部信息。在本文中，我们提出在工具变量框架下的依从者预期短缺处理效应（CRESTE）模型，以量化二元内生处理变量的CRESTE。利用二元工具变量的特殊性和Neyman正交化的特定形式，我们提出了一种两步估计程序，该程序可通过简单求解加权最小二乘回归和带估计权重的加权分位数回归来实现。我们发展了所提出估计量的渐近性质，并通过数值模拟确认其有效性和稳健的有限样本表现。最后，通过对国家职业培训伙伴关系法案研究的一个示例性分析，展示了所提出方法的实际效用。

articles.title_en: Nested Pseudo likelihood estimation of continuous-time dynamic discrete games
articles.title_cn: 连续时间动态离散博弈的嵌套伪似然估计
articles.abstract_en: We introduce a sequential estimator for continuous time dynamic discrete choice models (single-agent models and games) by adapting the nested pseudo likelihood (NPL) estimator of Aguirregabiria and Mira (2002, 2007), developed for discrete time models with discrete time data, to the continuous time case with data sampled either discretely (i.e., uniformly-spaced snapshot data) or continuously. We establish conditions for consistency and asymptotic normality of the estimator, a local convergence condition, and, for single agent models, a zero Jacobian property assuring local convergence. We carry out a series of Monte Carlo experiments using an entry-exit game with five heterogeneous firms to confirm the large-sample properties and demonstrate finite-sample bias reduction via iteration. In our simulations we show that the convergence issues documented for the NPL estimator in discrete time models are less likely to affect comparable continuous-time models. We also show that there can be large bias in economically-relevant parameters, such as the competitive effect and entry cost, from estimating a misspecified discrete time model when in fact the data generating process is a continuous time model.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过将Aguirregabiria和Mira（2002，2007）为离散时间模型和离散时间数据开发的嵌套伪似然（NPL）估计器适应到连续时间情形，引入了一种针对连续时间动态离散选择模型（单代理模型和博弈）的序贯估计器，其中数据可以是离散采样（即均匀间隔的快照数据）或连续采样。我们建立了该估计器的一致性和渐近正态性条件、局部收敛条件，以及对于单代理模型，确保局部收敛的零雅可比性质。我们使用一个包含五家异质企业的进入退出博弈进行了一系列蒙特卡洛实验，以确认大样本性质并展示通过迭代减少有限样本偏差。在我们的模拟中，我们表明，在离散时间模型中记录的NPL估计器的收敛问题不太可能影响可比较的连续时间模型。我们还表明，当数据生成过程实际上是连续时间模型时，估计一个错误设定的离散时间模型可能会导致经济相关参数（如竞争效应和进入成本）出现较大偏差。

articles.title_en: Quantile analysis of “hazard-rate” game models
articles.title_cn: “风险率”博弈模型的分位数分析
articles.abstract_en: This paper consists of an econometric analysis of a broad class of games of incomplete information. In these games, a player’s action depends both on her unobservable characteristic (the private information), as well as on the ratio of the distribution of the unobservable characteristic and its density function (which we call the ”hazard-rate”). The goal is to use data on players’ actions to recover the distribution of private information. We show that the structural parameter (the quantile of the unobservable characteristic, denoted by L) can be related to the reduced form parameter (the quantile of the data, denoted by Q) through a differential equation Q(α)=a(L(α),αL′(α)). We analyse the local and global identification of this equation in L. At the same time, under suitable assumptions, we establish the local and global well-posedness of the inverse problem Q=T(L). We solve the differential equation and, as a consequence of the well-posedness, we estimate nonparametrically the quantile and the c.d.f. function of the unobserved variables at a root-n speed of convergence (conditional on the quantile of the data being estimated at root-n). Moreover as the transformation of Q in L is continuous with respect to a topology that implies also the derivatives, we estimate nonparametrically the quantile density and the density the unobserved variables (that are continuous functions with respect to Q) at root-n speed of convergence. We provide also several generalisations of the model accounting for exogenuous variables, implicit expression of the strategy function and integral expression of the strategy function. Our results have several policy applications, including better design of auctions, regulation models, estimation of war of attrition in patent races, and public good contracts.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文对一类广泛的不完全信息博弈进行了计量经济学分析。在这类博弈中，参与者的行动既取决于其不可观测的特征（私人信息），也取决于不可观测特征的分布与其密度函数之比（我们称之为“风险率”）。目标是利用参与者行动的数据来恢复私人信息的分布。我们表明，结构参数（不可观测特征的分位数，记为L）可以通过微分方程Q(α)=a(L(α),αL′(α))与简化形式参数（数据的分位数，记为Q）相关联。我们分析了该方程在L中的局部和全局识别性。同时，在适当的假设下，我们建立了反问题Q=T(L)的局部和全局适定性。我们求解了该微分方程，并且作为适定性的结果，我们以根号n的收敛速度（在数据分位数以根号n速度估计的条件下）非参数地估计了不可观测变量的分位数和累积分布函数。此外，由于Q到L的变换在包含导数的拓扑意义下是连续的，我们以根号n的收敛速度非参数地估计了分位数密度和不可观测变量的密度（这些是关于Q的连续函数）。我们还提供了模型的若干推广，包括外生变量、策略函数的隐式表达式和策略函数的积分表达式。我们的结果具有多项政策应用，包括更好的拍卖设计、监管模型、专利竞赛中消耗战的估计以及公共品合同。

articles.title_en: A conditional linear combination test with many weak instruments
articles.title_cn: 具有许多弱工具变量的条件线性组合检验
articles.abstract_en: We consider a linear combination of jackknife Anderson-Rubin (AR), jackknife Lagrangian multiplier (LM), and orthogonalized jackknife LM tests for inference in IV regressions with many weak instruments and heteroskedasticity. Following I.Andrews (2016), we choose the weights in the linear combination based on a decision-theoretic rule that is adaptive to the identification strength. Under both weak and strong identifications, the proposed test controls asymptotic size and is admissible among certain class of tests. Under strong identification, our linear combination test has optimal power against local alternatives among the class of invariant or unbiased tests which are constructed based on jackknife AR and LM tests. Simulations and an empirical application to Angrist and Krueger’s (1991) dataset confirm the good power properties of our test.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑了一种由刀切安德森-鲁宾（AR）、刀切拉格朗日乘数（LM）和正交化刀切LM检验组成的线性组合，用于在具有许多弱工具变量和异方差性的IV回归中进行推断。遵循I.安德鲁斯（2016），我们基于一种对识别强度自适应的决策理论规则来选择线性组合中的权重。在弱识别和强识别下，所提出的检验控制了渐近规模，并在某类检验中是可容许的。在强识别下，我们的线性组合检验在基于刀切AR和LM检验构造的不变或无偏检验类中，对局部备择假设具有最优功效。模拟和对安格里斯特和克鲁格（1991）数据集的实证应用证实了我们检验的良好功效性质。

articles.title_en: Kolmogorov–Smirnov type testing for structural breaks: A new adjusted-range based self-normalization approach
articles.title_cn: 结构突变的Kolmogorov–Smirnov型检验：一种新的基于调整极差的自标准化方法
articles.abstract_en: A popular self-normalization (SN) approach in time series analysis uses the variance of a partial sum as a self-normalizer. This is known to be sensitive to irregularities such as persistent autocorrelation, heteroskedasticity, unit roots and outliers. We propose a novel SN approach based on the adjusted-range of a partial sum, which is robust to these aforementioned irregularities. We develop an adjusted-range based Kolmogorov–Smirnov type test for structural breaks for both univariate and multivariate time series, and consider testing parameter constancy in a time series regression setting. Our approach can rectify the well-known power decrease issue associated with existing self-normalized KS tests without having to use backward and forward summations as in Shao and Zhang (2010), and can alleviate the “better size but less power” phenomenon when the existing SN approaches (Shao, 2010; Zhang et al., 2011; Wang and Shao, 2022) are used. Moreover, our proposed tests can cater for more general alternatives. Monte Carlo simulations and empirical studies demonstrate the merits of our approach.
articles.abstract_cn: 时间序列分析中一种流行的自标准化（SN）方法使用部分和的方差作为自标准化器。已知该方法对持续自相关、异方差性、单位根和异常值等不规则性敏感。我们提出了一种基于部分和调整极差的新型SN方法，该方法对这些前述不规则性具有稳健性。我们开发了基于调整极差的Kolmogorov–Smirnov型检验，用于单变量和多变量时间序列的结构突变，并考虑在时间序列回归设置中检验参数恒定性。我们的方法可以纠正现有自标准化KS检验中众所周知的功效下降问题，而无需像Shao和Zhang（2010）那样使用向后和向前求和，并且可以缓解使用现有SN方法（Shao，2010；Zhang等，2011；Wang和Shao，2022）时出现的“更好的尺寸但更低的功效”现象。此外，我们提出的检验可以适应更一般的备择假设。蒙特卡洛模拟和实证研究证明了我们方法的优点。

articles.title_en: An identification and testing strategy for proxy-SVARs with weak proxies
articles.title_cn: 弱工具变量下代理SVAR的识别与检验策略
articles.abstract_en: When proxies (external instruments) used to identify target structural shocks are weak, inference in proxy-SVARs (SVAR-IVs) is nonstandard and the construction of asymptotically valid confidence sets for the impulse responses of interest requires weak-instrument robust methods. In the presence of multiple target shocks, test inversion techniques require extra restrictions on the proxy-SVAR parameters other than those implied by the proxies that may be difficult to interpret and test. We show that frequentist asymptotic inference in these situations can be conducted through Minimum Distance estimation and standard asymptotic methods if the proxy-SVAR can be identified by using ‘strong’ instruments for the non-target shocks; i.e., the shocks which are not of primary interest in the analysis. The suggested identification strategy hinges on a novel pre-test for the null of instrument relevance, based on bootstrap resampling, which is not subject to pre-testing issues. Specifically, the validity of post-test asymptotic inferences remains unaffected by the test outcomes due to an asymptotic independence result between the bootstrap and non-bootstrap statistics. The test is robust to conditionally heteroskedastic and/or zero-censored proxies, is computationally straightforward and applicable regardless of the number of shocks being instrumented. Some illustrative examples show the empirical usefulness of the suggested identification and testing strategy.
articles.abstract_cn: 当用于识别目标结构性冲击的代理变量（外部工具）较弱时，代理SVAR（SVAR-IV）中的推断是非标准的，并且为感兴趣的脉冲响应构建渐近有效的置信集需要弱工具稳健方法。在存在多个目标冲击的情况下，检验反转技术需要对代理SVAR参数施加除代理变量所隐含的限制之外的额外限制，这些限制可能难以解释和检验。我们表明，如果代理SVAR可以通过使用针对非目标冲击（即分析中非主要关注的冲击）的“强”工具来识别，那么在这些情况下，频率学派的渐近推断可以通过最小距离估计和标准渐近方法进行。所建议的识别策略依赖于一个新颖的预检验，用于检验工具相关性的原假设，该检验基于自助重抽样，并且不受预检验问题的影响。具体而言，由于自助统计量与非自助统计量之间的渐近独立性结果，检验后渐近推断的有效性不受检验结果的影响。该检验对条件异方差和/或零截断的代理变量具有稳健性，计算简便，并且适用于任何数量的被工具化冲击。一些说明性例子显示了所建议的识别与检验策略的经验实用性。

articles.title_en: Estimation and variable selection for high-dimensional spatial dynamic panel data models
articles.title_cn: 高维空间动态面板数据模型的估计与变量选择
articles.abstract_en: Spatiotemporal modeling of networks is of great practical importance, with modern applications in epidemiology and social network analysis. Despite rapid methodological advances, how to effectively and efficiently estimate the parameters of spatial dynamic panel models remains a challenging problem. To tackle this problem, we construct consistent complex least-squares estimators by the eigendecomposition of a spatial weight matrix method originally proposed for undirected networks. We no longer require all eigenvalues and eigenvectors to be real, which is a remarkable achievement as it implies that the proposed method is now applicable to spatiotemporal data modeling of directed networks. Under mild, interpretable conditions, we show that the proposed parameter estimators are consistent and asymptotically normally distributed. We also present a complex orthogonal greedy algorithm for variable selection and rigorously investigate its convergence properties. Moreover, we incorporate fixed effects into the spatial dynamic panel models and provide a model transformation so that the proposed method can also be applied to the transformed model. Extensive simulation studies and data examples demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.
articles.abstract_cn: 网络的时空建模具有重要的实际意义，在现代流行病学和社会网络分析中有着广泛应用。尽管方法学上取得了快速进展，如何有效且高效地估计空间动态面板模型的参数仍然是一个具有挑战性的问题。为解决这一问题，我们通过空间权重矩阵的特征分解方法构建了一致复最小二乘估计量，该方法最初是为无向网络提出的。我们不再要求所有特征值和特征向量为实数，这是一项显著成就，因为它意味着所提出的方法现在适用于有向网络的时空数据建模。在温和且可解释的条件下，我们证明了所提出的参数估计量具有一致性和渐近正态性。我们还提出了一种复正交贪婪算法用于变量选择，并严格研究了其收敛性质。此外，我们将固定效应纳入空间动态面板模型，并提供模型变换，使得所提出的方法也能应用于变换后的模型。广泛的模拟研究和数据实例证明了所提出方法的有效性。

articles.title_en: Tail behavior of ACD models and consequences for likelihood-based estimation
articles.title_cn: ACD模型的尾部行为及其对基于似然估计的影响
articles.abstract_en: We establish new results for estimation and inference in financial durations models, where events are observed over a given time span, such as a trading day, or a week. For the classical autoregressive conditional duration (ACD) models by Engle and Russell (1998), we show that the large sample behavior of likelihood estimators is highly sensitive to the tail behavior of the financial durations. In particular, even under stationarity, asymptotic normality breaks down for tail indices smaller than one or, equivalently, when the clustering behavior of the observed events is such that the unconditional distribution of the durations has no finite mean. Instead, we find that estimators are mixed Gaussian and have non-standard rates of convergence. The results are based on exploiting the crucial fact that for duration data the number of observations within any given time span is random. Our results apply to general econometric models where the number of observed events is random.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们为金融持续时间模型的估计和推断建立了新的结果，其中事件在给定的时间跨度内被观测，例如一个交易日或一周。对于Engle和Russell（1998）提出的经典自回归条件持续时间（ACD）模型，我们证明了似然估计量的大样本行为对金融持续时间的尾部行为高度敏感。特别是，即使在平稳性下，当尾部指数小于一时，或者等价地，当观测事件的聚类行为使得持续时间的无条件分布没有有限均值时，渐近正态性会失效。相反，我们发现估计量是混合高斯的，并且具有非标准的收敛速率。这些结果基于利用一个关键事实：对于持续时间数据，任何给定时间跨度内的观测数量是随机的。我们的结果适用于观测事件数量随机的通用计量经济模型。

articles.title_en: Robust testing for explosive behavior with strongly dependent errors
articles.title_cn: 强相依误差下爆炸行为的稳健检验
articles.abstract_en: A heteroskedasticity-autocorrelation robust (HAR) test statistic is proposed to test for the presence of explosive roots in financial or real asset prices when the equation errors are strongly dependent. Limit theory for the test statistic is developed and extended to heteroskedastic models. The new test has stable size properties unlike conventional test statistics that typically lead to size distortion and inconsistency in the presence of strongly dependent equation errors. The new procedure can be used to consistently time-stamp the origination and termination of an explosive episode under similar conditions of long memory errors. Simulations are conducted to assess the finite sample performance of the proposed test and estimators. An empirical application to the S&P 500 index highlights the usefulness of the proposed procedures in practical work.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种异方差自相关稳健（HAR）检验统计量，用于在方程误差强相依时检验金融或实物资产价格中是否存在爆炸根。发展了该检验统计量的极限理论，并将其扩展到异方差模型。与在强相依方程误差下通常导致尺寸失真和不一致的传统检验统计量不同，新检验具有稳定的尺寸性质。新方法可用于在长记忆误差的类似条件下一致地标记爆炸性发作的开始和结束。进行了模拟以评估所提检验和估计量的有限样本性能。对S&P 500指数的实证应用突出了所提方法在实际工作中的有用性。

articles.title_en: Distributed estimation and inference for spatial autoregression model with large scale networks
articles.title_cn: 大规模网络空间自回归模型的分布式估计与推断
articles.abstract_en: The rapid growth of online network platforms generates large-scale network data and it poses great challenges for statistical analysis using the spatial autoregression (SAR) model. In this work, we develop a novel distributed estimation and statistical inference framework for the SAR model on a distributed system. We first propose a distributed network least squares approximation (DNLSA) method. This enables us to obtain a one-step estimator by taking a weighted average of local estimators on each worker. Afterwards, a refined two-step estimation is designed to further reduce the estimation bias. For statistical inference, we utilize a random projection method to reduce the expensive communication cost. Theoretically, we show the consistency and asymptotic normality of both the one-step and two-step estimators. In addition, we provide theoretical guarantee of the distributed statistical inference procedure. The theoretical findings and computational advantages are validated by several numerical simulations implemented on the Spark system. Lastly, an experiment on the Yelp dataset further illustrates the usefulness of the proposed methodology.
articles.abstract_cn: 在线网络平台的快速增长产生了大规模网络数据，这给使用空间自回归（SAR）模型进行统计分析带来了巨大挑战。在这项工作中，我们为分布式系统上的SAR模型开发了一种新颖的分布式估计和统计推断框架。我们首先提出了一种分布式网络最小二乘近似（DNLSA）方法。这使得我们能够通过对每个工作节点上的局部估计量进行加权平均来获得一步估计量。随后，设计了一种精细的两步估计方法以进一步减少估计偏差。对于统计推断，我们利用随机投影方法来降低昂贵的通信成本。理论上，我们证明了一步和两步估计量的一致性和渐近正态性。此外，我们为分布式统计推断过程提供了理论保证。通过在Spark系统上实施的若干数值模拟验证了理论发现和计算优势。最后，在Yelp数据集上的实验进一步说明了所提出方法的实用性。

articles.title_en: Autoregressive conditional betas
articles.title_cn: 自回归条件贝塔
articles.abstract_en: This paper introduces an autoregressive conditional beta (ACB) model that allows regressions with dynamic betas (or slope coefficients) and residuals with GARCH conditional volatility. The model fits in the (quasi) score-driven approach recently proposed in the literature, and it is semi-parametric in the sense that the distributions of the innovations are not necessarily specified. The time-varying betas are allowed to depend on past shocks and exogenous variables. We establish the existence of a stationary solution for the ACB model, the invertibility of the score-driven filter for the time-varying betas, and the asymptotic properties of one-step and multistep QMLEs for the new ACB model. The finite sample properties of these estimators are studied by means of an extensive Monte Carlo study. Finally, we also propose a strategy to test for the constancy of the conditional betas. In a financial application, we find evidence for time-varying conditional betas and highlight the empirical relevance of the ACB model in a portfolio and risk management empirical exercise.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文介绍了一种自回归条件贝塔（ACB）模型，该模型允许具有动态贝塔（或斜率系数）的回归以及具有GARCH条件波动率的残差。该模型适用于文献中最近提出的（拟）得分驱动方法，并且是半参数的，因为创新项的分布不一定需要指定。时变贝塔被允许依赖于过去的冲击和外生变量。我们建立了ACB模型平稳解的存在性、时变贝塔的得分驱动滤波器的可逆性，以及新ACB模型的一步和多步QMLE的渐近性质。通过广泛的蒙特卡洛研究，我们研究了这些估计量的有限样本性质。最后，我们还提出了一种检验条件贝塔恒定性的策略。在一个金融应用中，我们发现了时变条件贝塔的证据，并强调了ACB模型在投资组合和风险管理实证练习中的实证相关性。

articles.title_en: The likelihood ratio test for structural changes in factor models
articles.title_cn: 因子模型中结构变化的似然比检验
articles.abstract_en: A factor model with a break in its factor loadings is observationally equivalent to a model without changes in the loadings but with a change in the variance of its factors. This approach effectively transforms a high-dimensional structural change problem into a low-dimensional problem. This paper considers the likelihood ratio (LR) test for a variance change in the estimated factors. The LR test implicitly explores a special feature of the estimated factors: the pre-break and post-break variances can be a singular matrix under the alternative hypothesis, making the LR test diverging faster and thus more powerful than Wald-type tests. The better power property of the LR test is also confirmed by simulations. We also consider mean changes and multiple breaks. We apply this procedure to the factor modeling of the US employment and study the structural change problem using monthly industry-level data.
articles.abstract_cn: 因子载荷发生断裂的因子模型在观测上等价于载荷不变但因子方差发生变化的模型。这种方法有效地将高维结构变化问题转化为低维问题。本文考虑了估计因子方差变化的似然比（LR）检验。LR检验隐含地探索了估计因子的一个特殊特征：在备择假设下，断裂前和断裂后的方差可以是奇异矩阵，这使得LR检验发散更快，因此比Wald型检验更有效。LR检验更好的功效性质也通过模拟得到了证实。我们还考虑了均值变化和多重断裂。我们将此程序应用于美国就业的因子建模，并使用月度行业层面数据研究结构变化问题。

articles.title_en: Bellman filtering and smoothing for state–space models
articles.title_cn: 状态空间模型的贝尔曼滤波与平滑
articles.abstract_en: This paper presents a new filter for state–space models based on Bellman’s dynamic-programming principle, allowing for nonlinearity, non-Gaussianity and degeneracy in the observation and/or state-transition equations. The resulting Bellman filter is a direct generalisation of the (iterated and extended) Kalman filter, enabling scalability to higher dimensions while remaining computationally inexpensive. It can also be extended to enable smoothing. Under suitable conditions, the Bellman-filtered states are stable over time and contractive towards a region around the true state at every time step. Static (hyper)parameters are estimated by maximising a filter-implied pseudo log-likelihood decomposition. In univariate simulation studies, the Bellman filter performs on par with state-of-the-art simulation-based techniques at a fraction of the computational cost. In two empirical applications, involving up to 150 spatial dimensions or highly degenerate/nonlinear state dynamics, the Bellman filter outperforms competing methods in both accuracy and speed.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文基于贝尔曼动态规划原理提出了一种新的状态空间模型滤波器，允许观测方程和/或状态转移方程存在非线性、非高斯性和退化性。由此产生的贝尔曼滤波器是（迭代和扩展）卡尔曼滤波器的直接推广，能够在保持计算成本低廉的同时扩展到更高维度。它还可以扩展以实现平滑。在适当条件下，贝尔曼滤波状态随时间稳定，并在每个时间步向真实状态周围的区域收缩。通过最大化滤波器隐含的伪对数似然分解来估计静态（超）参数。在单变量模拟研究中，贝尔曼滤波器的性能与最先进的基于模拟的技术相当，而计算成本仅为其一小部分。在两个实证应用中，涉及多达150个空间维度或高度退化/非线性状态动态，贝尔曼滤波器在准确性和速度方面均优于竞争方法。

articles.title_en: Advances in nowcasting economic activity: The role of heterogeneous dynamics and fat tails
articles.title_cn: 经济活动的即时预测进展：异质动态与肥尾的作用
articles.abstract_en: A key question for households, firms, and policy makers is: how is the economy doing now? This paper develops a Bayesian dynamic factor model that allows for nonlinearities, heterogeneous lead–lag patterns and fat tails in macroeconomic data. Explicitly modeling these features changes the way that different indicators contribute to the real-time assessment of the state of the economy, and substantially improves the out-of-sample performance of this class of models. In a formal evaluation, our nowcasting framework beats benchmark econometric models and professional forecasters at predicting US GDP growth in real time.
articles.abstract_cn: 家庭、企业和政策制定者面临的一个关键问题是：当前经济状况如何？本文开发了一个贝叶斯动态因子模型，该模型允许宏观经济数据中存在非线性、异质领先-滞后模式和肥尾。明确建模这些特征改变了不同指标对经济状况实时评估的贡献方式，并显著提高了这类模型的样本外表现。在一项正式评估中，我们的即时预测框架在实时预测美国GDP增长方面优于基准计量经济模型和专业预测者。

articles.title_en: Observation-driven filtering of time-varying parameters using moment conditions
articles.title_cn: 基于矩条件的观测驱动时变参数滤波
articles.abstract_en: We develop a new and flexible semi-parametric approach for time-varying parameter models when the true dynamics are unknown. The time-varying parameters are estimated using a recursive updating scheme that is driven by the influence function of a conditional moments-based criterion. We show that the updates ensure local improvements of the conditional criterion function in expectation. The dynamics are observation driven, which yields a computationally efficient methodology that does not require advanced simulation techniques for estimation. We illustrate the new approach using both simulated and real empirical data and derive new, robust filters for time-varying scales based on characteristic functions.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们为真实动态未知的时变参数模型开发了一种新的、灵活的半参数方法。时变参数通过一种递归更新方案进行估计，该方案由基于条件矩准则的影响函数驱动。我们证明，这些更新确保了条件准则函数在期望上的局部改进。动态是观测驱动的，这产生了一种计算高效的方法，不需要先进的模拟技术进行估计。我们使用模拟和真实经验数据来说明新方法，并基于特征函数推导出新的、稳健的时变尺度滤波器。

articles.title_en: Identification of heterogeneous elasticities in gross-output production functions
articles.title_cn: 总产出生产函数中异质性弹性的识别
articles.abstract_en: This paper presents the identification of heterogeneous elasticities in gross-output production functions with non-separable unobserved productivity. We propose that the ex-ante flexible input cost shares identify the heterogeneous output elasticities with respect to flexible inputs for each firm. Applying the proposed method to a panel of firms in the food production industry in Chile, we find that the extent of heterogeneity in the output elasticities with respect to intermediate inputs has significantly declined from 1985 to 1995, with its distribution tending to concentrate toward zero as time progresses.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提出了在具有不可分离的未观测生产率的总产出生产函数中识别异质性弹性的方法。我们提出，事前灵活投入成本份额可以识别每个企业相对于灵活投入的异质性产出弹性。将所提出的方法应用于智利食品生产行业的企业面板数据，我们发现，从1985年到1995年，相对于中间投入的产出弹性的异质性程度显著下降，其分布随时间推移趋向于集中于零。

articles.title_en: Estimation and inference by stochastic optimization
articles.title_cn: 随机优化的估计与推断
articles.abstract_en: In non-linear estimations, it is common to assess sampling uncertainty by bootstrap inference. For complex models, this can be computationally intensive. This paper combines optimization with resampling: turning stochastic optimization into a fast resampling device. Two methods are introduced: a resampled Newton–Raphson (rnr) and a resampled quasi-Newton (rqn) algorithm. Both produce draws that can be used to compute consistent estimates, confidence intervals, and standard errors in a single run. The draws are generated by a gradient and Hessian (or an approximation) computed from batches of data that are resampled at each iteration. The proposed methods transition quickly from optimization to resampling when the objective is smooth and strictly convex. Simulated and empirical applications illustrate the properties of the methods on large scale and computationally intensive problems. Comparisons with frequentist and Bayesian methods highlight the features of the algorithms.
articles.abstract_cn: 在非线性估计中，通常通过自助法推断来评估抽样不确定性。对于复杂模型，这可能计算量很大。本文将优化与重抽样相结合：将随机优化转变为快速的重抽样工具。介绍了两种方法：重抽样牛顿-拉夫森（rnr）算法和重抽样拟牛顿（rqn）算法。两者都能产生可用于在单次运行中计算一致估计、置信区间和标准误的抽样。这些抽样由梯度和海森矩阵（或其近似）生成，这些梯度和海森矩阵基于每次迭代中重抽样的数据批次计算。当目标函数光滑且严格凸时，所提出的方法能快速从优化过渡到重抽样。模拟和实证应用展示了这些方法在大规模和计算密集型问题上的性质。与频率学派和贝叶斯方法的比较突出了这些算法的特点。

articles.title_en: Nonparametric estimation of stochastic frontier models with weak separability
articles.title_cn: 弱可分性随机前沿模型的非参数估计
articles.abstract_en: We propose a robust and versatile approach to estimate the stochastic frontier model which avoids parametric assumptions. Our approach requires a single continuous covariate which monotonically influences the conditional mean of inefficiency. Subject to these conditions, the frontier and the conditional mean of inefficiency can be estimated nonparametrically. The estimator we propose uses local least squares and marginal integration making it easy to implement across statistical software. A range of Monte Carlo simulations suggests that when our main identification condition holds, our proposed estimator outperforms other proposals that currently exist. Finally, we provide an application to the study of undercounting COVID-19 cases across the United States. Whereas our method indicates significant undercounting, consistent with existing evidence, other nonparametric methods suggest far less undercounting.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种稳健且多用途的方法来估计随机前沿模型，该方法避免了参数假设。我们的方法要求一个单一的连续协变量，该协变量单调影响无效率的条件均值。在这些条件下，前沿和无效率的条件均值可以非参数地估计。我们提出的估计器使用局部最小二乘和边际积分，使其易于在各种统计软件中实现。一系列蒙特卡洛模拟表明，当我们的主要识别条件成立时，我们提出的估计器优于目前存在的其他提议。最后，我们将其应用于研究美国COVID-19病例的低报问题。尽管我们的方法表明存在显著的低报，与现有证据一致，但其他非参数方法表明低报程度要小得多。

articles.title_en: Semiparametric Bayesian estimation of dynamic discrete choice models
articles.title_cn: 动态离散选择模型的半参数贝叶斯估计
articles.abstract_en: We propose a tractable semiparametric estimation method for structural dynamic discrete choice models. The distribution of additive utility shocks in the proposed framework is modeled by location-scale mixtures of extreme value distributions with varying numbers of mixture components. Our approach exploits the analytical tractability of extreme value distributions in the multinomial choice settings and the flexibility of the location-scale mixtures. We implement the Bayesian approach to inference using Hamiltonian Monte Carlo and an approximately optimal reversible jump algorithm. In our simulation experiments, we show that the standard dynamic logit model can deliver misleading results, especially about counterfactuals, when the shocks are not extreme value distributed. Our semiparametric approach delivers reliable inference in these settings. We develop theoretical results on approximations by location-scale mixtures in an appropriate distance and posterior concentration of the set identified utility parameters and the distribution of shocks in the model.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种可处理的半参数估计方法，用于结构动态离散选择模型。在所提出的框架中，加性效用冲击的分布通过位置-尺度混合的极值分布来建模，其中混合成分的数量可变。我们的方法利用了极值分布在多项选择设置中的解析可处理性以及位置-尺度混合的灵活性。我们使用哈密顿蒙特卡洛和近似最优的可逆跳跃算法实现贝叶斯推断。在我们的模拟实验中，我们表明，当冲击不服从极值分布时，标准动态logit模型可能给出误导性结果，尤其是在反事实分析方面。我们的半参数方法在这些设置中提供了可靠的推断。我们发展了关于位置-尺度混合在适当距离下的逼近以及模型中集合识别的效用参数和冲击分布的后验集中性的理论结果。

articles.title_en: High-dimensional IV cointegration estimation and inference
articles.title_cn: 高维IV协整估计与推断
articles.abstract_en: A semiparametric triangular systems approach shows how multicointegrating linkages occur naturally in an I(1) cointegrated regression model when the long run error variance matrix in the system is singular. Under such singularity, cointegrated I(1) systems embody a multicointegrated structure that makes them useful in many empirical settings. Earlier work shows that such systems may be analyzed and estimated without appealing to the associated I(2) system but with suboptimal convergence rates and potential asymptotic bias. The present paper develops a robust approach to estimation and inference of such systems using high dimensional IV methods that have appealing asymptotic properties like those known to apply in the optimal estimation of cointegrated systems (Phillips, 1991). The approach uses an extended version of high-dimensional trend IV (Phillips, 2006, 2014) estimation with deterministic orthonormal instruments. The methods and derivations involve new results on high-dimensional IV techniques and matrix normalization in the limit theory that are of independent interest. Wald tests of general linear restrictions are constructed using a fixed-b long run variance estimator that leads to robust pivotal HAR inference in both cointegrated and multicointegrated cases. Simulations show good properties of the estimation and inferential procedures in finite samples. An empirical illustration to housing stocks, starts and completions is provided.
articles.abstract_cn: 一个半参数三角系统方法展示了当系统中的长期误差方差矩阵奇异时，多协整联系如何在I(1)协整回归模型中自然出现。在这种奇异性下，协整的I(1)系统体现了多协整结构，使其在许多实证环境中很有用。早期的工作表明，这样的系统可以在不涉及相关的I(2)系统的情况下进行分析和估计，但收敛速度次优且可能存在渐近偏差。本文开发了一种使用高维IV方法的稳健估计和推断方法，这些方法具有吸引人的渐近性质，类似于已知在协整系统的最优估计中适用的性质（Phillips, 1991）。该方法使用了扩展版本的高维趋势IV（Phillips, 2006, 2014）估计，采用确定性正交工具。方法和推导涉及高维IV技术和极限理论中矩阵归一化的新结果，这些结果具有独立的意义。使用固定b长期方差估计量构建Wald检验，该估计量在协整和多协整情况下都能导致稳健的枢轴HAR推断。模拟显示估计和推断程序在有限样本中具有良好的性质。提供了对住房存量、开工和竣工的实证说明。

articles.title_en: The fixed-b limiting distribution and the ERP of HAR tests under nonstationarity
articles.title_cn: 非平稳性下HAR检验的固定b极限分布与拒绝概率误差
articles.abstract_en: We show that the limiting distribution of HAR test statistics under fixed-b asymptotics is not pivotal when the data are nonstationary (i.e., time-varying autocovariance structure). It takes the form of a complicated function of Gaussian processes and depends on the second moments of the relevant series (e.g., of the regressors and errors for the case of the linear regression model). Hence, fixed-b inference methods based on stationarity are not theoretically valid in general. The nuisance parameters entering the fixed-b limiting distribution can be consistently estimated under small-b asymptotics but only with nonparametric rate of convergence. We show that the error in rejection probability (ERP) is an order of magnitude larger than that under stationarity and can be also larger than that of HAR tests based on HAC estimators under conventional asymptotics. These theoretical results reconcile with recent finite-sample evidence showing that existing fixed-b HAR tests can perform poorly when the data are nonstationary. They can be conservative under the null hypothesis and have non-monotonic power under the alternative hypothesis irrespective of how large the sample size is. Based on the new nonstationary fixed-b distribution, we propose a feasible method that controls the null rejection rates well regardless of whether the data are stationary or not and of the strength of the serial dependence as verified for some representative data-generating processes in a simple location model.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们证明，当数据非平稳（即时变自协方差结构）时，固定b渐近下HAR检验统计量的极限分布不是枢轴的。它表现为高斯过程的复杂函数形式，并依赖于相关序列的二阶矩（例如，线性回归模型中的回归量和误差）。因此，基于平稳性的固定b推断方法在理论上一般不成立。进入固定b极限分布的 nuisance 参数可以在小b渐近下一致估计，但仅以非参数收敛速度。我们表明，拒绝概率误差（ERP）比平稳性下的误差大一个数量级，也可能大于基于HAC估计量的HAR检验在常规渐近下的误差。这些理论结果与最近的有限样本证据一致，表明当数据非平稳时，现有的固定b HAR检验可能表现不佳。它们在原假设下可能保守，在备择假设下具有非单调功效，无论样本量多大。基于新的非平稳固定b分布，我们提出了一种可行的方法，无论数据是否平稳以及序列依赖的强度如何，都能很好地控制原假设拒绝率，这在简单位置模型中的一些代表性数据生成过程中得到了验证。

excluded_items.title_en: What leads to measurement errors? Evidence from reports of program participation in three surveys
